saw_lines: Ethical buyers check fabric, fit and origin before they buy, and replace a piece only when the old one wears out.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a buyer decides whether your brand fits them.
Your 11 of 24 copy ads open on one line, “le plaisir de remettre des”. Name 2 or 3 new angles from your own product and test them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: 11 of 24 copy ads open on “le plaisir de remettre des”, so buyers wanting another reason to buy skip you. Test 2 or 3 new angles from the product, like the mid-season layers and the Bon Jean, against it.
One exact copy runs in 11 of 24 ads, so buyers who see one get the same words and tune out. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and creative in each ad so no two ads look the same.

None of your 28 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to trust before clicking. Collect one proof point, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.
0 of 24 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Give them one, like a first order offer or a bundle, and open every new ad with it, not the closing line.

ads_1: Mid-season layers and the Bon Jean, each tested against the current opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram, your linked channels
